scripts.build: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && bun run --filter 'vision-frontend' build
scripts.generate-locales-if-not-ci: sh -c 'if [ -z "$CI" ]; then node scripts/generate-locales.js; else echo "Skipping locales generation in CI"; fi'
scripts.docker:dev: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up
scripts.docker:dev:rebuild: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.docker:clean: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.clean.yml up --build
scripts.docker:clean:down: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.clean.yml down
scripts.docker:clean:reset: npm run generate-locales-if-not-ci && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.clean.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.clean.yml up --build
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs -f app
